gap: No result ChatGPT got that I could open states that Gamakay's first-generation Phoenix and Mercury magnetic switches only work in the TK75HE V1, while only the TK75HE V2 takes other brands' magnetic switches and the Phoenix V3 is the generation that fits other makers' boards.
standout_why: I compared against three result pages that opened. The HLPlanet guide (cited) names the TK75HE V2 and NS75 with Phoenix V3 as the silent option at $89.99, but gives no generation limit. thegadgetverse (in the results, not cited) already lists Phoenix V3 as fitting Wooting 60HE, Womier SK75 TMR, NS75 and Neo65 Sonic HE+ and not Corsair K70 Max or Keychron HE, so the cross-brand fit is not new. torontokeyboardman does not mention Gamakay. None of the three carries Gamakay's own V1-only notice. Five cited or ranked pages could not be read (RTINGS body did not render, dopyoe and mechanicalkeyboard.net gave certificate errors, both Reddit threads were blocked), so the score is 2 rather than 3.
decides: It confirms the Gamakay TK75HE V2 with Phoenix V3 as the pick and adds the exclusion a buyer needs: Gamakay still sells 'Hall Effect v1' Phoenix/Mercury switches from $3.99 that it says only work in the TK75HE V1, and a mechanical 'Phoenix V2 Silent' that is a different product. Spares or a top-up set for the V2 must be the 'Hall Effect V3' listing. It also gives the Wooting 80HE a quiet route: HLPlanet names Phoenix as one of two silent switches for Wooting boards, though Wooting's own FAQ names no third-party switch and HLPlanet's test board was the 60HE, not the 80HE.
